app.name: SecondLoop
app.tagline: A private secretary that keeps every action accountable.
chat.starter: What would you like to move forward today?

composer.attachmentOnlyPrompt: Inspect the attached file and explain only what you can verify.

composer.attachmentRemoveFailed: This attachment could not be removed safely. Try again.
today.title: Today
today.subtitle: A source-backed view of what deserves attention.
today.noSources: Connect Mail or Tasks to build an authoritative brief.
today.noItems: Nothing urgent is confirmed for today.
today.sourcesUnavailable: The local sources for Today are temporarily unavailable.
today.noReplies: No confirmed message needs an immediate reply.
today.mailNextStep: Connect Mail before source-backed replies can appear here.
today.noApprovals: No external action is waiting for your decision.
today.noCommitments: No unfinished task is marked as a commitment.
today.captureDescription: The task is saved to the local source of truth. A reminder is stored as a separate schedule.
today.taskPlaceholder: For example: reply to the quarterly review
today.scheduleReminderHint: Turn this off to save only the task.
today.captureFailed: The task and reminder were not fully saved. Review and retry; the same request will not be duplicated.
connections.subtitle: Model and Mail credentials remain with the trusted host.
connections.model.checkingHint: Reading the public status from operating-system secure storage.
connections.model.readyHint: Model settings are saved and can be tested below.
connections.model.missingHint: Save an endpoint and model name, then test the connection.
connections.model.errorHint: Secure-storage status is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
connections.mail.checkingHint: Reading the public state of the Mail Connector.
connections.mail.readyHint: At least one Mail account is connected.
connections.mail.missingHint: Connect Mail before Today can show source-backed replies.
connections.mail.errorHint: Mail connection state is temporarily unavailable.
connections.requestFailed: Connection state is temporarily unavailable. No credential was exposed to this screen; try again later.
connections.mailDiagnostic: The connector reported a state that needs attention. Reconnect it or retry diagnostics later.
connections.mailDetailEmptyDescription: Connect an available account to inspect its scopes and send-approval policy here.
connections.mailOnboarding.title: Accounts you control
connections.mailOnboarding.description: Add an IMAP/SMTP account without preparing files or exposing its password to the agent.
connections.mailOnboarding.securityBound: Passwords go directly to the encrypted Host vault. They are never returned to this screen or made available as agent tools.
connections.mailOnboarding.loadFailed: Saved Mail accounts could not be read. No credential was returned.
connections.mailOnboarding.emptyDescript: Choose a provider, enter an app password, and SecondLoop will save and test the connection locally.
connections.mailOnboarding.removeDescrip: SecondLoop will remove the saved settings and encrypted credential for {account}. This cannot be undone.
connections.mailOnboarding.formDescripti: The account identity and server settings are stored in SQLite. The app password is stored separately in the encrypted Host vault.
connections.mailOnboarding.appPasswordHi: Gmail and iCloud normally require an app-specific password. Re-enter a current or new password whenever you update an account.
connections.mailOnboarding.saved: Settings and credential were saved. The connection still needs to pass its live test.
connections.mailOnboarding.invalid: Complete every required field and use valid port numbers.
connections.mailOnboarding.saveFailed: The account was not fully saved. The password field has been cleared; review the settings and try again.
connections.mailOnboarding.testFailed: The settings were saved, but the live connection test failed. Check the provider, username, app password, and account security policy.
foundation.accounts.emptyDescription: No Mail account is connected. Configure a supported Mail Connector, then return to check its status.
actions.requestFailed: The action ledger is temporarily unavailable. No action will execute automatically in this state.
actions.actionFailed: This action failed. Reconcile its authoritative state before choosing a next step.
actions.detailEmptyTitle: Select an action to inspect its authoritative preview
actions.detailEmptyDescription: The preview lists the target, risk, immutable arguments, and idempotency state. No external action runs without it.
memory.requestFailed: The memory ledger is temporarily unavailable. This screen will not display stale cached content.
memory.detailEmptyTitle: Select a memory to inspect its provenance
memory.detailEmptyDescription: Details include evidence, confidence, sensitivity, and retention. Forgetting always requires confirmation.
foundation.actions.emptyDescription: No persisted external action is waiting for your decision. Create an authoritative preview before approving it here.
foundation.memory.emptyDescription: No committed memory matches this scope. Adjust the search or explicitly ask the agent to remember a preference.
settings.dataProtection.title: Privacy & data
settings.dataProtection.description: Export an App-bound encrypted backup or restore local data after validation.
settings.dataProtection.unavailable: The local data-protection service is temporarily unavailable.
settings.dataProtection.scopeNote: Backups use a key protected by the operating system and can be restored after reinstall by the same OS user. Cross-user and cross-machine restore are not promised. The active SQLite database is not encrypted at rest.
settings.dataProtection.restoreDescripti: SecondLoop authenticates the envelope, validates the App identity and SQLite integrity, then stages the restore and restarts the local sidecar under supervision.
settings.dataProtection.restoreWarning: Restore replaces the active local database. The current database and its WAL/SHM files are retained first as a rollback copy.
settings.dataProtection.exported: The encrypted backup was exported. Its filesystem path never entered the renderer.
settings.dataProtection.restored: The backup passed validation and the local sidecar completed a controlled restart.
settings.dataProtection.failed: The data-protection operation did not complete. The active database is unchanged; review and try again.
settings.notifications.title: Notifications
settings.notifications.description: Review local reminder availability and its execution boundary.
settings.notifications.localHint: Reminders are triggered only by persisted Scheduler entries.
settings.notifications.approvalNote: Notifications do not bypass approval or present suggestions as confirmed tasks.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.description: SecondLoop product build and local runtime information.
settings.about.localFirst: This is a local-first Desktop build. It does not provide cloud sync, a hosted model, or cross-device consistency.
